about.title: About Mananect
about.heading: Rebuilding a name that once stayed on paper
about.body:
Mananect was a business name that once stayed theoretical. This time, with AI and one person, we are rebuilding it for real.

The goal is an AI Operating Company, an OS (Mioca) where AI runs a company's operations. But we do not lead with the grand vision. We ship one useful thing first: ShipProof, which turns fast, AI-written code into a state you can explain and prove. What we did not fix, we write down as not fixed. We do not bend the numbers.

More products will follow, each an AI Worker in time. All built on the same stance: understand, operate, verify. That is Mananect.
